_about: Wallets to report on every rerun of token-forensics while they stay relevant. scripts/watch_wallets.py reads this, reports each wallet's activity since last_checked, then advances last_checked. Retire a wallet by setting active=false with a reason; never delete, so the history of why it was watched survives.
